تغوفلت (form VI)
# تُغُوفِلْتُ (tuḡūfiltu) /tu.ɣuː.fil.tu/: first-person singular past passive of تَغَافَلَ (taḡāfala)
# تُغُوفِلْتَ (tuḡūfilta) /tu.ɣuː.fil.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of تَغَافَلَ (taḡāfala)
# تُغُوفِلْتِ (tuḡūfilti) /tu.ɣuː.fil.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of تَغَافَلَ (taḡāfala)
# تُغُوفِلَتْ (tuḡūfilat) /tu.ɣuː.fi.lat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
